description: Apply a previewed reconciliation run (write — admin role). Asynchronous. The run must be 'previewed' and expected_to_version must match, so a stale preview is refused rather than applied.

expected_to_version.description: The target catalog version from the run detail — guards against applying a stale preview

run_id.description: Reconciliation run UUID — obtain from scf_list_reconciliation_runs or scf_preview_catalog_reconciliation

name: scf_apply_catalog_reconciliation
